paragraphs: Mentioned in Chullin 30b: Rava inspected an arrow for him, and a bird was slaughtered with it in flight.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ל: gives Chullin 30b. The exact William Davidson vocalized passage has Rava checking an arrow for full Rabbi Yonah bar Tachlifa, supporting the heading title expansion and recipient.

The subsequent slaughtering verb does not restate its subject; passive English leaves the actor unassigned. With-it refers contextually to the arrow, and in-flight preserves בהדי דפרח. No authority identity or new historical finding follows.
